---
title: "delete all merged git branch (alias  gbpurge)"
description: |
    housekeeping local branches
date: "2025-01-13"
format:
  html:
    code-fold: false
---

Just add this to ~/.bashrc 

`alias gbpurge='git branch --merged | grep -Ev "(\*|master|develop|staging)" | xargs -n 1 git branch -d'`

source : https://stackoverflow.com/questions/17983068/delete-local-git-branches-after-deleting-them-on-the-remote-repo
